preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 2*10**5 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: Number of vertices in each test case is between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= 10**6 for ai in ais)
preconditions.description: Altitude of each vertex is between 1 and 1,000,000.
Total number of vertices across all test cases does not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, int) for line in output)
postconditions.description: Each output line is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= result <= (n * (n - 1)) // 2 for result, n in zip(output, ns))
postconditions.description: Each result is a non-negative integer not exceeding the maximum possible number of edges in a complete graph with n vertices.
